lines.en: ( The wind and the sun are having a disagreement.
“I can blow trees to the ground!
“I can push ships across the ocean.
I can make hurricanes and tornadoes!
lines.zh: 我能造出飓风和龙卷风！

lines.en: “Well, I can melt all the snow on the mountains.
lines.zh: “那我呢，我能把山上的雪全部融化。

lines.en: I can dry up an entire lake.
I can make a sidewalk so hot that it cooks an egg!
lines.zh: 我能把人行道晒得烫到可以煎熟一个鸡蛋！

lines.en: ” Just then, they see a man walking along the road in his winter jacket .
lines.zh: ”就在这时，他们看见一个人穿着冬衣在路上走。

lines.en: “Let’s have a contest to see who is more powerful,” says the wind.
lines.zh: “我们来比一比，看谁更厉害吧，”风说。

lines.en: “Whoever can remove the man’s jacket first wins.
lines.zh: “谁先让那个人脱下外套，谁就赢。

lines.en: He blows a gust of cold wind at the man.
lines.zh: 他朝那个人吹去一阵冷风。

lines.en: The man shivers and zips up his jacket.
lines.zh: 那个人打了个哆嗦，把外套拉链拉上了。

lines.en: What a cold and windy day!
The wind blows even harder and turns the rain into snow.
lines.zh: 风刮得更猛了，把雨吹成了雪。

lines.en: “Snow wasn’t in the weather forecast today...
lines.zh: “今天的天气预报可没说要下雪啊……

lines.en: ” He pulls his hood over his head.
The wind blows his strongest gust towards the man, but the man’s jacket stays on.
lines.zh: 风使出最猛的一阵吹向那个人，可他的外套还是穿着没脱。

lines.en: It’s a bit fresh today…” he says.
lines.zh: 今天有点凉飕飕的……”他说。
“看来要来一场冬季暴风雪了……”

lines.en: He zips the jacket higher to cover his nose.
lines.zh: 他把外套拉链拉得更高，一直盖到鼻子。

lines.en: This is impossible,” says the wind.
First the sun shines enough to stop the snow.
lines.zh: 太阳先照得雪停了下来。

lines.en: Then the sun pulls the clouds apart and gently shines down on the man.
lines.zh: 然后太阳拨开云层，温柔地照在那个人的身上。

lines.en: Suddenly, it is a beautiful spring day.
lines.zh: 转眼间，变成了美好的春日。

lines.en: The weather sure is strange around here!
lines.zh: 这地方的天气可真奇怪！
他把外套的拉链拉开了。

lines.en: The sun gently wiggles her fingers and increases the temperature.
lines.zh: 太阳轻轻动了动手指，把温度又抬高了一些。

lines.en: ” the man says as he begins to sweat.
He lies down on the grass for a nap in the warm sun.
lines.zh: 他躺在草地上，在暖洋洋的阳光里打了个盹。

lines.en: Moral: Sometimes warmth and gentleness can achieve more than strength and force.
lines.zh: 寓意：有时候，温和比强力更能办成事。
